propositions: A failed pre-create pending save must produce zero Jira calls and return an item-scoped persistence failure.

After Jira returns a key, the canonical rebar-id label must be attached first, entity property attempted second as optional enrichment, then the known key persisted through RP-02 facade; any failure must report the known key without deleting the remote issue.
Create timeout or connection loss must never trigger blind replay; observation through replay-safe seams or deferred pending records must prevent duplicate creation across restart.
Keyed recovery must perform zero search; keyless recovery must require both three misses and 3600 seconds; per-entry recovery failure must not block unrelated tickets.
Lifecycle intents must execute only after their remote postcondition is proven, while preserving create-before-link order, hierarchy deferral, tombstone suppression, and per-ticket tallies.
